subject: general
question: Which one of the following is defined as 'a program that runs in the background on your computer, sending information about your browsing habits to the company that installed it on your computer'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Spyware**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Spyware** is defined as a program that runs in the background on your computer, sending information about your browsing habits to the company that installed it on your computer.
 
• It is often installed without the user's knowledge and can gather various types of data, including personal information, internet browsing habits, and other activities.
 
• Spyware can lead to significant privacy issues and can also slow down the performance of the computer.
 
• It is considered malicious software and is often bundled with other software or downloaded from malicious websites.
 
• Spyware removal tools and antivirus software can help detect and remove spyware from the computer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Malware** is a general term that encompasses various types of malicious software, including viruses, worms, trojans, ransomware, and spyware.
 
• **Adware** is software that automatically displays or downloads advertising material when a user is online, often bundled with free software.
 
• **Grayware** refers to software that is not outright malicious but may be unwanted and may cause undesirable effects, such as adware and spyware.
 
• It is essential to keep your system and software up-to-date and use reliable security tools to protect against spyware and other types of malware.
